item.title: Raycast launches on Windows with native design and instant file search

item.title: Robots are getting neuromorphic skin that can feel pain
item.description: Human skin transmits sensory information as electrical pulses, or spikes, that encode signals related to pressure and pain. NRE-skin mimics this biological process by converting pressure inputs into spiking signals that can be processed in real time.Read Entire Article

item.title: While the world cools on EVs, Norway pushes to 96% electric sales
item.description: Last year, 95.5 percent of all newly registered vehicles in Norway were electric. While consumers in Europe and other markets are pivoting away from Tesla and toward hybrid vehicles, the Scandinavian country is staying firmly on course toward full EV adoption.Read Entire Article
